title: August and the Machine
author: Rafael Villalobos
blurb: Jonah Thackeray, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
